name: SpliceAI_predict_splice
description: Predict splice-altering effects using SpliceAI. DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, and DS_DL are already delta scores for acceptor gain/loss and donor gain/loss; do not recompute them from REF/ALT raw scores. The maximum delta is max(DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, DS_DL), not donor loss. SpliceAI scores are source leads or computational/splicing route triggers only, not independently included in an ACMG system preview.

variant.description: Variant in chr-pos-ref-alt format (e.g., chr8-140300616-T-G) or colon-separated

distance.description: Distance parameter for model (default: 50). Larger values capture more distal effects.

mask.description: Use masked scores (recommended for variant interpretation). Raw scores better for alternative splicing analysis.

fields.model_version_source: Illumina SpliceAI model release (Jaganathan et al. 2019, PMID:30661751); SpliceAI has a single public model version

scores.description: Per-transcript score rows. DS_* are delta scores and DP_* are their relative positions.

DP_AG.description: Genomic-coordinate-relative position of the acceptor gain event; do not invert the sign for minus-strand transcripts.

DP_AL.description: Genomic-coordinate-relative position of the acceptor loss event; do not invert the sign for minus-strand transcripts.

DP_DG.description: Genomic-coordinate-relative position of the donor gain event; do not invert the sign for minus-strand transcripts.

DP_DL.description: Genomic-coordinate-relative position of the donor loss event; do not invert the sign for minus-strand transcripts.

max_delta_score.description: Maximum of DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, and DS_DL; this is not specifically donor loss.

run_metadata.description: Actual request settings and provider-reported model/annotation versions; unavailable versions remain null.

name: SpliceAI_get_max_delta
description: Get max(DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, DS_DL) for variant triage. This value is the four-channel maximum, not donor loss DS_DL. The score is a source lead or computational/splicing route trigger only, not independently included in an ACMG system preview.

fields.model_version_source: Illumina SpliceAI model release (Jaganathan et al. 2019, PMID:30661751); SpliceAI has a single public model version

max_delta_score.description: Maximum of DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, and DS_DL; this is not specifically donor loss.

run_metadata.description: Actual request settings and provider-reported model/annotation versions; unavailable versions remain null.

name: SpliceAI_predict_pangolin
description: Predict splice-altering effects using Pangolin model (alternative to SpliceAI). Pangolin uses a different architecture and may provide complementary predictions. Returns splice effect scores per transcript. Useful for validation or when SpliceAI gives borderline results.
